inputs.name: brief
inputs.description: A brief for a test batch of expense claims: the company, the employees and the claims wanted, the expense policy the audit applies, and the mix of compliant and rule-breaking claims

output.description:
One employee's expense report in the test batch: the employee, their claims with the verdict expected on each, and the
report as the employee submitted it

fields.name: claims
fields.description: The employee's claims, each with the photo of its receipt and the verdict the audit should reach

fields.name: expense_report
fields.description: The expense report as the employee submitted it, without the verdicts, which are the audit's to reach
